findings.evidence: Basic.lean:155-163 `isCollinearSafe_iff_cons` proves `IsCollinearSafe O ↔ ∀ (s : Multiset V) (p : V), ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, O (z • p ::ₘ (1 - z) • p ::ₘ s) = O (p ::ₘ s)`; the RHS mentions no `erase`, so the decidability assumption is strictly stronger than the condition it defines. grep: `code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Jets/Observable/Basic.lean:146,227,329`, `Counterexamples.lean:67,143` all carry `[DecidableEq V]`; `code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:26` does not.
findings.fix: Make the cons form primitive: `def IsCollinearSafe (O : Multiset V → X) : Prop := ∀ (s : Multiset V) (p : V), ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, O (z • p ::ₘ (1 - z) • p ::ₘ s) = O (p ::ₘ s)`, under `[AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]` only. Keep `splitCollinear` and its lemmas in their own `[DecidableEq V]` section, and turn the current definition into the characterisation `IsCollinearSafe.apply_splitCollinear`/`isCollinearSafe_iff_splitCollinear` (hypothesis `[DecidableEq V]`, `hp : p ∈ s`) — the roadmap §0.3 form then remains a theorem of the file while `IsCollinearSafe`, `IsIRCSafe`, `ircSafeSubring`, the finset closure lemmas and both counterexamples drop `[DecidableEq V]`.
findings.issue: `IsCollinearSafe` is defined via `splitCollinear`, forcing `[DecidableEq V]` (section variable at line 146) into the predicate and hence into every downstream statement: `IsIRCSafe` (232), `ircSafeSubring` (278), `mem_ircSafeSubring` (288), `isIRCSafe_finsetSum` (293), `isIRCSafe_finsetProd` (300), `isCollinearSafe_multisetSum`/`isIRCSafe_multisetSum`/`isIRCSafe_invariantMassSq`/`_of_finite` (329), and in Counterexamples.lean `not_isCollinearSafe_multiplicity` (67) and `not_isCollinearSafe_leadingEnergy` (143 section). The assumption is only an artefact of `Multiset.erase`; the roadmap's canonical `V` (DIS Kinematics/Basic.lean:26: `variable (V : Type) [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V]`) carries no `DecidableEq`, so Layers 1–4 would have to thread one through every safety statement.

summary: The safety predicates and all their consequences carry a [DecidableEq V] assumption that the PR's own isCollinearSafe_iff_cons shows is not needed for the content, and which the roadmap's canonical momentum space does not supply. Otherwise the statements sit at the natural level.
